comment:
* The interface of BpfMap. This could be used to inject for testing.
 * So the testing code won't load the JNI and update the entries to kernel.
 *
 * @param <K> the key of the map.
 * @param <V> the value of the map.

methods.name: void updateEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Update an existing or create a new key -> value entry in an eBbpf map.

methods.name: void insertEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException, IllegalStateException
methods.comment: If the key does not exist in the map, insert key -> value entry into eBpf map.

methods.name: void replaceEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException, NoSuchElementException
methods.comment: If the key already exists in the map, replace its value.

methods.name: boolean insertOrReplaceEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Update an existing or create a new key -> value entry in an eBbpf map. Returns true if
     * inserted, false if replaced. (use updateEntry() if you don't care whether insert or replace
     * happened).

methods.name: boolean deleteEntry(K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Remove existing key from eBpf map. Return true if something was deleted.

methods.name: K getNextKey(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Get the key after the passed-in key.

methods.name: K getFirstKey() throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Get the first key of the eBpf map.

methods.name: boolean isEmpty() throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Returns {@code true} if this map contains no elements.

methods.name: boolean containsKey(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Check whether a key exists in the map.

methods.name: V getValue(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Retrieve a value from the map.

methods.name: public void forEach(ThrowingBiConsumer<K, V> action) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Iterate through the map and handle each key -> value retrieved base on the given BiConsumer.
     * The given BiConsumer may to delete the passed-in entry, but is not allowed to perform any
     * other structural modifications to the map, such as adding entries or deleting other entries.
     * Otherwise, iteration will result in undefined behaviour.

methods.name: public void clear() throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Clears the map. The map may already be empty.
     *
     * @throws ErrnoException if the map is already closed, if an error occurred during iteration,
     *                        or if a non-ENOENT error occurred when deleting a key.
